text: 10 OVERDOSAGE: 10.1 Signs and symptoms The symptoms of overdosage of clidinium bromide are excessive dry mouth, blurred vision, urinary hesitancy and constipation which are caused by the anticholinergic actions. 10.2 Treatment Chlordiazepoxide hydrochloride overdosage symptoms include: drowsiness, confusion, coma and diminished reflexes. Call you doctor or local Poison Control Center if overdosage is suspected.
